info.name: DecentEdu API (v1)
info.description:
Laravel 13 API for the Safe Eduman rebuild — multi-branch school/college ERP.

## Auth
Sanctum SPA **cookie session** (not bearer tokens). Flow:
1. `Auth > Get CSRF Cookie` — sets the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie in Postman's cookie jar.
2. `Auth > Login` — creates the session cookie.

A collection-level pre-request script reads the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie and sends it back as the `X-XSRF-TOKEN` header on every request (matching `resources/js/lib/api.ts`). Keep the Postman cookie jar enabled.

## Branch context
All authenticated `v1` routes run behind `auth:sanctum` + `branch` middleware. The active branch comes from the session (falling back to the user's default branch). Use `Auth > Switch Branch` to change it.

## Variables
- `base_url` — API host, default `http://localhost:8000`
- `email` / `password` — login credentials
- resource id vars (`page_id`, `post_id`, …) for path params.
